asks_for_member_b: the A/B pairing axes B intends to match on, so A can state which of them the captures can bound
B's minimum session count per condition, because that sets when a spread becomes reportable at all
whether B consumes feature sets by variant name (preferred) or by raw term list, so the labelling stays unambiguous
a joint decision on the docs/01 §20.1 naming question W07 left open, since it changes which mean any band would apply to

candidate_tolerance_basis_once_data_exis.form: per outcome, the sample (n-1) spread across independent boots, with the number of boots stated and the confidence the count supports - the same discipline W07 applies to repeatability

provenance.session: H8 box-cooling 600 s, stage H8-C, 2026-11-01, image 01cedce3...

decision_owner: Member A and Member B jointly; neither side freezes this alone
deliverable: A-W14-04 pairing criterion refinement - Member A input side

join_keys_b_can_use.boot_id: the session key; one boot_id is one session
join_keys_b_can_use.conditioning_fingerprint: hash of device_ms/state/duty/door/boot per row, so two variants provably share one physical run
join_keys_b_can_use.device_ms: per-boot monotonic time; not comparable across boots
join_keys_b_can_use.phase: baseline / cooling / recovery from W07's split_phases
join_keys_b_can_use.variant: name from cg_w14_spatial.VARIANTS, carrying feature_terms, feature_roles, is_chamber_air, includes_hot_side

notes: Nothing here is a proposed threshold. A number appearing in this file is an observation about one session, and each one says so in its own field name.
The status stays TEAM_DEPENDENCY until B signs the values; it is not BLOCKED_HARDWARE, because no hardware is needed to agree the form.

partial_mean_rule.consequence_for_b: feature sets differ by which probes they use, not by silently averaging fewer terms under the same name
partial_mean_rule.rule: a mean over fewer terms is a different quantity and must not reuse the label (docs/01 517-530); W07 excludes partial-term rows from a phase series and counts them

verdict.blocked_on: Member B's pairing axes plus the sessions that would bound them

what_the_real_data_cannot_support: any run-to-run matching band for temperature, gradient or duty: one session is one session and its within-session drift is a different quantity
a door-open condition-matching tolerance: no such event is recorded
an electrical matching gate: the values exist but nothing recorded their validity
per-channel identity across boots: the H8S schema-3 frames carry no sensor ROM ids, so a later capture's t1 is a slot name, not a probe
a hot-side channel in any chamber-air band: it is a surface, and W07's includes_hot_side plus cg_w14_spatial.require_air keep it out

ablation_report_verdict.note: variant differences below are measured on one session's rows, which controls physical conditions exactly and therefore says nothing about run-to-run behaviour: both facts are published together

drop_one_feature_sensitivity.not_a_tolerance_because: it is one session's value for one duty and one start condition; a matching tolerance has to bound run-to-run difference, which needs independent sessions
drop_one_feature_sensitivity.read_as: how much the published response depends on the sensor set, measured on identical rows of the same session - a confounding magnitude, not a matching tolerance

within_session_variability.why: these numbers describe how far apart the probes sat inside one run. A run-to-run tolerance asks how far two *runs* sit apart, and one run cannot answer that at any confidence

why_no_number: independent thermal sessions on disk: 1; a repeat spread needs at least 3
door-open events recorded anywhere in committed data: 0 of 957 rows (the rest are CLOSED or UNKNOWN), so the disturbance axis has no measured response to bound
rows whose current value carries no recorded status in this capture: 957, so an electrical gate would key on unqualified values
device_ms is per-boot and host wall-clock is not device time, so pairing across sessions cannot be done on absolute timestamps either
